title: Invited: SambaNova SN40L: Unleashing Agentic AI with Dataflow
problem: AI inference clouds must efficiently support diverse models for interactive agentic workloads (LLM assistants, chatbots, agents) while maintaining high token generation performance during memory-bound decode phase and supporting rapid model switching at scale.
motivation: Token-per-watt efficiency during decode is critical for inference economics; model hosting costs dominate when serving diverse model architectures at scale.
method: SambaNova SN40L Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU) combines dataflow with three-tier memory (SRAM, HBM, DDR). Dataflow enables aggressive compute-graph fusion into single kernels for peak token generation; memory hierarchy reduces hardware footprint to host trillions of parameters.
key_novelty: Dataflow-based reconfigurable unit with three-tier memory system optimized for token-generation phase of LLM inference and multi-model hosting.
contributions: 3x faster token generation vs. DGX H100
3x lower energy consumption vs. DGX H100
19x lower model hosting costs vs. DGX H100 through efficient parameter storage in HBM/DDR

metrics.speedup: 3x faster token generation vs. DGX H100

limitations: Invited paper; no detailed evaluation details or limitations discussed.
primary_theme: dataflow-based unit for efficient multi-model LLM inference
